newsitem.title: USA: Sylvester Stallone's daughter has heart operation.
newsitem.headline: Sylvester Stallone's daughter has heart operation.

text.p: Actor Sylvester Stallone's two and one-half month-old daughter, Sophia Rose Stallone, underwent successful open heart surgery and remained at UCLA Medical Centre on Wednesday.
The surgery, performed on Tuesday, closed a hole in her heart, said Stallone's publicist Paul Bloch.
"I've been blessed with two miracles within the past nine weeks, that of my daughter being born and that of my daughter being reborn," Stallone said in a statement.
Sophia Rose was born on Aug. 27 to Stallone and his fiancee, model Jennifer Flavin.
Stallone, best known for the "Rocky" and "Rambo" movies, left the set of "Copland", which was being filmed in New York and New Jersey, to be with Flavin for the birth.
Sophia will remain in hospital for the next few days for observation before being released.
